answer: Sybil resistance here works by forcing every new agent to lock a slashable stake that cannot be withdrawn until a multi-epoch unbonding delay ends. A fresh identity starts at the nadir of trust and can only rise by accumulating an atlas of countersigned work other miners can audit. The unbonding delay is a jetty: all exits funnel through one slow, inspectable channel, so a swarm of fake accounts immobilizes capital for a long time and can be slashed together if their answers show coordinated copying.
